name: create_directories
description: Create one or more folders or directories. When the user specifies a known location such as Desktop, Downloads, or Documents, pass that location using parent_path.

directory_paths.description: The folder name or folder names to create. Usually relative to parent_path. Example: 'Homework', not 'Desktop/Homework' when parent_path is 'desktop'.

parent_path.description: Optional parent location. Use values such as 'desktop', 'downloads', 'documents', or an absolute filesystem path. For 'create Homework on my desktop', use parent_path='desktop'.
